model: Aurora HydroLink2 for TruClimate 700 Single Screw Chiller
equipment_type: Water-cooled screw chiller / heat pump controller
applies_to: WaterFurnace TruClimate 700 single screw water-to-water chillers with the Aurora HydroLink2 controller.
summary: BACnet objects of the Aurora HydroLink2 controller on the TruClimate 700 single screw chiller. The list covers system enable, emergency shutdown, cold and hot water setpoints with on/off offsets, network capacity and valve positions, evaporator and condenser water temperatures and limits, compressor refrigerant and drive data, bypass and isolation valve control, and model and serial number registers.
firmware: HydroLink2 Single Screw BACnet objects version 1.00
notes: Writable points are marked with the BACnet priorities they accept (in1, in4, in5, in8, in16) or 'Any Input'; they are shown here as commandable (C).
Many object names carry over from the dual scroll HydroLink2 list, with 'Evap' and 'Cond' in place of 'Load' and 'Source'.
AV 79 and BV 45 are printed with the name 'Do Not Map - FACTORY USE ONLY!!!'.
MV 501 OperationMode_c is printed with default 8, which is not one of its listed states (1-7, 99).
BV 310 NetIsoCtrl_c and BV 311 Net3wayCtrl_c carry descriptions copied from the delta-control rows; check their meaning on site.
Valve position and capacity settings are printed as fractions (default 0.5 = 50 %) although the unit column says %. The sheet does not state the BACnet transport.

integration.summary: Keep BV 37 Enabled and set BV 36 to Network while the BAS is in control. Pick the control method on MV 2 (setpoint, network, setpoint with enable) and the operating mode on MV 501, then write the cold and hot water setpoints AV 500/501. Watch MV 0 status, MV 1 mode and the evaporator leaving water temperature.

minimum_points.why: System enable; compressor stays off when Disabled

minimum_points.why: Set to Network while the BAS has control

minimum_points.name: OperationMode_c
minimum_points.why: Operating mode: cooling, heating, free cooling, off...

minimum_points.name: AlarmReset_c
minimum_points.why: Alarm reset; return to Normal after the lockout clears

minimum_points.name: SystemStatus_st
minimum_points.why: Overall status: normal, alarm, shutdown, load shed...

integration.enable: BV 37 SystemEnable_c must be Enabled for the compressor to run, and the BAS sets BV 36 NetworkControl_c to Network when it takes control. MV 2 picks setpoint (AV 500/501), network or setpoint-with-enable control; MV 501 sets the operating mode. BV 2 EmShutdown_c forces an emergency shutdown.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 506/507 take BAS cold and hot water control temperatures when MV 502/503 are set to option 4 (Network). AV 508 and AV 510-515 take network loop temperatures; BV 503 switches the geothermal loop values between local and network.
gotchas: AV 307 NetVarSpdPct_c sets compressor capacity under network control; AV 327/328 hold the minimum and maximum capacity.
BV 5 EnableManualOverride_c enables manual output overrides; normal logic keeps running underneath.
Model and serial number registers (AV 210-227) are writable; don't write them from the BMS.
Clear BV 33 AlarmReset_c back to Normal once the lockout condition is gone.
